title: Profitability and Financial Leverage: Evidence from a Quasi-Natural Experiment
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Single treatment date: post95 = year > 1995 (federal trademark anti-dilution law); treated = firms holding famous trademarks.
eligible_reason: Single-date design. DiD = treated x post95 with post95 = 1(year > 1995) for every treated firm, so there is one adoption cohort. Every main regression (rep_code_dh_gs.do) also uses CEM analytic weights [aweight = cem_weights], lagged time-varying firm controls (l_asset_tangibility, l_logat, l_Q, ...), firm-specific pre-trend x year terms (c.pretrend_X#c.year) and gvkey + naics4 x year FE. The firm-year panels (main_panel.dta, extended_panel.dta) are built from CRSP/Compustat and are not shipped.
design_notes: rep_code_dh_gs.do reproduces all tables and figures from main_panel.dta / extended_panel.dta (not included); readme.txt gives the construction code from compustat_annual.dta, CRSP volatility and CEM weights. Tables: ROA, sales growth, PCM (profitability); book/market leverage, debt and equity issuance (leverage); interactions with size, tax, Z-score, WW, KZ (heterogeneity); event-time plots treated__X.
data_access_note: CRSP/Compustat-based panels not shipped; public inputs shipped (ritter.dta, graham_tax_rates.dta, patent_counts.dta, tm_data_byfirm.dta); cem_weights.dta not shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (abstract from data/frame/mnsc.jsonl). Not staggered regardless of data.
